At The Pet Beastro, we specialize in natural, nutritious pet foods you can trust. No recalls, just healthy options! Our mission is to help pet parents discover why raw, dehydrated, organic, and natural diets are the best for their pets' health and longevity. We offer a wide selection of pet food, treats, and supplements to support digestion, coat shine, joint health, allergy relief, and overall well-being.

Since 2003, we’ve proudly served the Metro Detroit community, providing holistic, natural solutions for both dogs and cats. Visit us at our Madison Heights or Warren locations.

🍖 Raw, dehydrated, organic, and natural foods for dogs and cats
💊 Supplements that support digestion, joint health, allergy relief, and overall well-being
🍪 Treats made with clean, wholesome ingredients

Visit Us at one of our locations:
📍 Madison Heights: 27637 John R Road, Madison Heights, Michigan 48071
📍 Warren: 13828 East 14 Mile Road, Warren, MI 48088
